rich_text.plain_text: Summary

text.content: In this lesson, you investigated a workflow that appeared to suffer from repeated agent failures. By following the execution step by step, you discovered that the protocol layer was functioning correctly and the real issue was in the orchestration logic that connected the parser to the branching node.

rich_text.plain_text: In this lesson, you investigated a workflow that appeared to suffer from repeated agent failures. By following the execution step by step, you discovered that the protocol layer was functioning correctly and the real issue was in the orchestration logic that connected the parser to the branching node.

text.content: Being able to separate integration problems from orchestration problems is an essential debugging skill. As workflows become more complex, many failures occur not because an agent or tool is broken, but because information is passed or interpreted incorrectly between otherwise healthy components.
